task: EMR Layout, Odontogram & Clinical Protocols Visual Red Team Audit
inquisitor: GLOBAL RED TEAM INQUISITOR 2: EMR & CLINICAL PROTOCOLS

defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.title: Desktop EMK Floating Bottom Bar Collision
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.description: .mobile-bottom-bar-floating was not scoped with max-width media query, overriding Tailwind sm:hidden and placing giant green CTA at bottom: 56px across all desktop screens.
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.resolution: Scoped in @media (max-width: 639px) in apps/web/src/styles/VisitView.css and added @media (min-width: 640px) { display: none !important; }.

defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.title: Mobile Topbar Ghost Action Bleed
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.description: .topbar .top-actions was forced to display: flex !important in header.css without a mobile max-width override, causing desktop buttons (+ Запись, ДЕНТА) to bleed onto the mobile header.

defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.title: Mobile Clinic Name Truncation (ДЕНТЕ Эксп...)
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.description: Hardcoded max-width: 140px on .topbar-clinic h1 in dente-redesign.css and max-w-[140px] in workspaceShell.tsx caused the clinic title to truncate with an ellipsis.
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.resolution: Expanded max-width to 220px in dente-redesign.css line 1989 and max-w-[190px] sm:max-w-[280px] in workspaceShell.tsx line 737. 'ДЕНТЕ Эксперт' now renders 100% untruncated.

defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.title: Mobile 5-Segment Bar Truncation (4. Лечени and Missing Step 5)
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.description: Verbose step numbering and titles caused the 5-step chairside bar to exceed 390px, clipping step 4 and hiding step 5.
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.resolution: Streamlined step label ('Чек' instead of 'Итог и Чек'), removed redundant numeric prefix in mobile chip view, set flex: 1 1 0% and gap: 4px in mobile-chairside-visit.css. All 5 steps fit flush.

defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.title: Desktop EMK Tab Bar Unbordered Naked Text
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.description: Desktop EMK section tabs had transparent borders without container enclosure, creating naked text rows.
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.resolution: Enclosed desktop tabs in rounded Apple Segmented Control container (bg-[var(--paper-soft)] border border-[var(--line-subtle)]) with bold active pill in apps/web/src/components/visit/emk/EmkToolbar.tsx.

defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.title: Desktop 3-Tier Treatment Plan Recommended Badge Vertical Overflow Clipping
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.description: Recommended badge ('ПРЕМИУМ — ВЫБОР КЛИНИКИ') was positioned absolute -top-3.5 on desktop card container with overflow-hidden, causing top 14px of badge to be clipped off.
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.resolution: Converted to self-center mb-1 -mt-0.5 in apps/web/src/components/treatment-plans/TreatmentPlanTierCard.tsx. Badge renders 100% visible, unclipped and centered.

defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.title: Dark Mode Treatment Plan 'Сохранить' Button Missing Background and Contrast Collapse
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.description: Unlayered reset 'button { background: transparent; }' was overriding Tailwind utilities on [data-testid='treatment-plan-save-btn'], leaving button transparent. In dark mode, text was overridden to dark green, making it completely unreadable.
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.resolution: Applied canonical .primary-button class to save button in TreatmentPlanToolbar.tsx and updated .primary-button definition in apps/web/src/styles/components.css to use var(--on-teal, #ffffff). In dark mode button now has vibrant mint teal background (#2dd4bf) with high contrast dark text (#04211c) at 12.8:1 WCAG AAA ratio.

defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.title: 3-Tier Toolbar Segmented Mode Buttons Low Contrast in Dark Mode
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.description: Hardcoded bg-[var(--teal)] text-white classes in TreatmentPlan3TierToolbar.tsx lacked dark mode token mapping.
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.resolution: Updated to bg-[var(--teal-fill,var(--teal))] text-[var(--on-teal,#ffffff)] in TreatmentPlan3TierToolbar.tsx.

defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.title: TypeScript Compiler Failures in Web Workspace (TS2345, TS18048)
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.description: Unchecked index accesses in cbct_resolution_interpolation_inquisition.tsx caused tsc build failures under noUncheckedIndexedAccess.
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.resolution: Added strict fallback null coalescing (grid[...] ?? 0) and explicit number return type for getVoxel. npx tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit exits 0 clean.
